source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The owned test marks manager lookup and card-change invalidation as separate sections with standalone comments and blank-line groups. Each section then has a comment stating the state or action it tests. The accepted current file keeps both headings. This makes the change from directory tests to manager-cache scenarios clear. It is a local accepted example, not a fixed blank-line count, a comment-per-statement rule or a substitute for correct assertion messages and cleanup. No test ran; missing primary comments keep this source lesson at zero full-audit credit.
title: The address-book cache test separates new scenarios with standalone heading comments
